mapper.sql: r.id AS id, r.tenant_id AS tenantId, r.role_code AS roleCode, r.role_name AS roleName, r.scope_type AS scopeType, r.status AS status
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM sys_role r WHERE r.status = 1
AND r.tenant_id = 0 AND r.scope_type = 0
AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.scope_type >= 1
AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.scope_type = 2
ORDER BY r.scope_type, r.role_code

SELECT
FROM sys_role r WHERE r.id = #{roleId} LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id AS id, p.perm_code AS permCode, p.perm_name AS permName, p.perm_type AS permType FROM role_permission rp INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY p.perm_code
